title: 2021 Topps Series 1 #70 Detroit Tigers Team Card - Baseball
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The MLB 2021 Topps Series 1 Detroit Tigers Team Card #70 is a standard-sized trading card featuring the Detroit Tigers from the Major League Baseball (MLB) set. Manufactured by Topps in 2021, this card is part of the 70 Years of Topps Baseball insert set, celebrating the team's history and players. Made of card stock, this original sports trading card is a valuable collectible for fans of the Detroit Tigers and baseball enthusiasts alike. With its English language text and MLB World Series event/tournament association, this card is a must-have addition to any trading card collection.
